title: Lime crescent on blue
description: A broad lime crescent sweeps through saturated blue with medium dry pigment stippling and a quiet central opening.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE complete high-resolution wide 16:9 landscape image: text-free grainy airbrush abstract print artwork, a full-bleed background for editorial design.
Medium: soft analog spray paint and tactile dry pigment stippling. Soft large-scale color transitions with visible fine-to-medium sprayed pigment grains at the transitions; an authentic flat printed or airbrushed surface. High-contrast soft color, expressive composition, useful quiet space. Every mark is abstract, not a representation of scenery.
Primary color family: rich blue #007EBD, luminous yellow-lime #D6FF62; allowed extensions brighter blue #168DDD, deep blue #0565BB, ice blue #C2EDFF, and restrained forest depth #132B26. Keep the pigments vivid.
NO text, lettering, logo, symbols, user interface, editorial card, frame, border, watermark, objects, people, horizon, sky, cloudscape, fields, leaves, water, landscape, 3D objects, glossy highlights, glass, pebbled or frosted textures, embossed texture, or photographed materials. No contact sheet, collage of multiple designs, tiled preview, or mockup. No sharp vector outlines, hard geometry, thick paint ridges, or large liquid splashes. This is the background only, no text at all.

Reference image: use the supplied approved-favorite grainy airbrush background for its vivid pigment, dry-grain softness, and color confidence, while creating a new composition. Extend that direction with one LARGE crescent-like lime sweep curling from the lower-left through the bottom and up the right edge, enclosing an open saturated-blue center. The crescent is broad and incomplete, has fully feathered sprayed edges and varied pigment density, and must not read as a moon, object, outlined circle, or logo. A small ice-blue overspray at the opposite upper edge balances it. Blue remains dominant. Medium dry stippling, richer and more organic than a clean digital gradient.

title: Overlapping lime and ice spray
description: Large asymmetric lime and ice-blue pigment forms overlap a rich-blue opening, with flat matte color, diffuse overspray edges, and fine dry powder stippling.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-resolution wide 16:9 landscape abstract airbrush background, full bleed, no text or graphics.

A bold two-dimensional analog airbrush print made of FLAT MATTE SPRAYED PIGMENT. Use only colored ink density and very fine dry powder stippling to make texture, on an optically flat smooth surface. The image must have NO relief, NO light catching texture, NO cellular or granular glass structure. Fine dry flat noise, continuous diffuse overspray boundaries, soft optical transitions. Think opaque matte color sprayed in layers, never a photograph of a textured material.

Composition: rich saturated Recoup blue #007EBD and brighter blue #168DDD dominate the whole lower half and an asymmetric opening through the middle. A large irregular luminous lime #D6FF62 spray form extends inward from the upper-left and left edge, and a softer ice-blue #C2EDFF spray form enters from the top-right. They overlap subtly with uneven pigment density and soft falling-off boundaries. These are purely abstract colored pigment masses, not clouds in the sky. Let the blue cut a quiet broad passage between them at the lower-middle, no centered glow or symmetrical vignette. Keep color vivid and bold, never washed out grey. Lime and ice have distinct masses and unequal scale, not a repeat of a crescent or circular halo. Fine powder stippling becomes more visible only in transitional edges.

The full image is entirely NONREPRESENTATIONAL and FLAT: no text, letters, logos, symbols, interface, objects, figures, border, frame, watermark, scenery, horizon, sky, cloudscape, water, leaves, landscape, moon, orb, bubbles, glass, frost, embossed relief, cellular surface, pebbles, droplets, wet paint, shiny highlights, large paint splashes, woven paper, or mockup. No raised dots or material shadows. No split canvas or collage. One complete high-resolution background image.
